gold: Richter's transformation presenting as penile ulcer (transformation of chronic lymphocytic leukemia to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma)

selector.rationale: The presence of a dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes with clonal IgH gene rearrangement and the clinical presentation of painful swelling and ulceration of the glans penis support this diagnosis.
